title: Disinfection, Irrigation Hygiene, Exclusion, Environment, and Scouting Workbook
purpose: Support validated sanitation sequences, irrigation hygiene, structural exclusion, environmental disease prevention, and risk-zone monitoring.

sections.title: Cleaning vs Disinfection Sequence Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Was the surface physically cleaned before relying on disinfection?

sections.title: Disinfectant Contact-Time Verification
sections.decisionPrompt: Did the actual prepared surface remain treated for the required labeled contact time?

sections.title: Water-System Hygiene Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the water system show a transfer pathway that requires maintenance, testing, or validated treatment?

sections.title: Pest Exclusion Inspection
sections.decisionPrompt: Which structural entry point presents the highest preventable pest-entry risk?

sections.title: Environmental Disease-Risk Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Which measured environmental factor is most plausibly increasing disease pressure in this zone?

qualityRules: Follow product-specific instructions for chemical sanitation.
Treat microbial detections as context requiring interpretation, not automatic disease proof.
Verify structural repairs and environmental changes with follow-up monitoring.
Record representative risk zones, not only convenient sensor locations.
